description: This file contains extension methods for string manipulation within the OrchardCore.ContentManagement.Utilities namespace, including text formatting, sanitization, and validation functions.

classes.name: StringExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for string manipulation and validation.

methods.name: CamelFriendly
methods.description: Converts a camel case string into a space-separated, more human-readable format.

methods.name: Ellipsize
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified length, appending an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: OrDefault
methods.description: Returns a LocalizedString with the text or a default value if null or empty.

methods.name: RemoveTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string, optionally decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: ReplaceNewLinesWith
methods.description: Replaces newline characters in a string with a specified replacement string.

methods.name: IsValidUrlSegment
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid URL segment according to RFC 3987.

methods.name: ToSafeName
methods.description: Generates a sanitized, valid technical name from a string.

methods.name: IsReservedContentName
methods.description: Checks if a string is a reserved content name.

methods.name: RemoveDiacritics
methods.description: Removes diacritic marks from characters in a string.

methods.name: Strip
methods.description: Removes specified characters or characters matching a predicate from a string.

methods.name: Any
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified characters are present in the string.

methods.name: All
methods.description: Checks if all of the specified characters are present in the string.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Replaces characters in a string based on a mapping from one set to another.

methods.name: ReplaceAll
methods.description: Replaces multiple substrings in a string based on a dictionary of replacements.

methods.name: TrimEndString
methods.description: Removes a specified suffix from the end of a string if present.

methods.name: ReplaceLastOccurrence
methods.description: Replaces the last occurrence of a substring with another string.

methods.name: GetSafeHTMLInputName
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be a safe HTML input name by removing invalid characters.
